name: Trae Agent
description: ByteDance's LLM-based CLI agent for general software-engineering tasks, with a research-friendly modular design.
whatItDoes: Trae Agent takes natural-language instructions such as fixing a bug or adding tests and works through them in a repository. Its transparent structure is aimed at people studying or extending coding agents.
howItWorks: The trae-cli runs an agent loop with file-editing, bash and structured-thinking tools, records detailed trajectories and supports MCP services. Providers and models are set in a YAML config or environment variables.

requirements.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
requirements.description: Or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, DOUBAO_API_KEY depending on provider

run: trae-cli run "Create a hello world Python script"
models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter, Doubao and others
